adapterLine.skill: On GitHub Copilot, read [the Copilot adapter](../pstack-copilot/SKILL.md) once per session before you follow this skill. It maps the Cursor names in pstack skills to GitHub Copilot.
adapterLine.agent: On GitHub Copilot, read the `pstack-copilot` skill once per session before you follow this file. It is `pstack-copilot/SKILL.md` in the same skills folder as `poteto-mode`: `~/.copilot/skills/`, `.github/skills/`, or `~/.pstack/current/skills/`. It maps the Cursor names in pstack to GitHub Copilot.

watch.why: The Copilot adapter skill is the Copilot counterpart of upstream's Claude Code adapter. A change to a Cursor-name mapping upstream may need the same change in the Copilot tables.
Defines the role lines, defaults, and budget rules that mappings/models.json and the adapter's setup-pstack section restate.
Holds the Subagents rules, model defaults, and routing that the poteto-mode agent, the always-applied instruction, and the model mapping depend on.
Each upstream agent's frontmatter is mapped by an agent rule.
Playbooks name the Cursor tools, /loop, control skills, and Bugbot steps that the adapter's tables map.
The adapter's Bugbot row links to this file for triaging Copilot review comments.
Script behavior and runtime requirements are documented in the script features and the limitations.
